    Keyboard shortcuts

    Space
    Play / pause (with audio when a track is loaded)
    ← →
    Step one frame (Shift: ten)
    [ ]
    Previous / next style for the selected layer
    1–6
    Aspect ratio (in Evolve: keep variation)
    M · E · R
    Mutate · Evolve · Randomize the selected layer
    K
    Show or hide the key lane
    Delete
    Remove the selected key
    Alt + ← →
    Nudge the selected key one frame
    ⌘Z / ⇧⌘Z
    Undo / redo
    S
    Save look
    G
    Safe-area guides
    X
    Export
    ?
    This list
    ◇ on a row
    Key that value at the playhead; edit a keyed value to add a key
    Double-click slider
    Reset that value
